clue.text: A lord but for him fortune lay in obscurity

indicators.note: letters lost in obscurity are blurred and jumbled, so the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nobleman reflects that, but for one person, his fortune would have stayed unknown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in obscurity' tells you to rearrange FORTUNE LAY. Little Lord Fauntleroy is the title character of Frances Hodgson Burnett's novel, a boy who becomes heir to an earldom.
explanation.definitionFit: Little Lord Fauntleroy is the famous fictional boy peer, heir to an English earl.

clue.text: Time for an accident

explanation.definitionFit: Autumn is the season of falling leaves; a tumble is a common mishap.

clue.text: Rapid growth those who are not down advocate?

parts.note: ups are the opposite of downs
to urge is to advocate

explanation.surface: Optimists recommend a burst of growth.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden rise or surge is rapid growth.

clue.text: He understands what others are thinking despite being pedestrian

definitions.text: He understands what others are thinking despite being pedestrian

parts.words: He understands what others are thinking despite being pedestrian
parts.note: a mind-reader described as one whose gift is unexciting, playing on 'pedestrian' as dull

explanation.surface: A dull person who still knows exactly what others think.
explanation.definitionFit: A mind-reader claims to know others' thoughts.

clue.text: To take food without liquid is a relief

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the eating goes around the liquid

parts.note: to eat is to take food
semen is a bodily fluid

explanation.surface: Eating dry food brings comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: An easement is an easing or alleviation, an old word for relief.

clue.text: A kind of map is able to render an ancient language

parts.note: OS is the Ordnance Survey, Britain's official map-maker
can means is able

explanation.surface: A map that can translate an old tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: OS is the Ordnance Survey, which makes Britain's standard maps.
explanation.definitionFit: Oscan was an ancient Italic language of southern Italy.

clue.text: Cold fish embracing the church

indicators.note: one piece holds the other in its arms, so it goes round it

parts.note: the ID, or IDE, is a freshwater fish of the carp family
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A chilly fish is wrapped around a church building.
explanation.definitionFit: Something chilled with ice is cold.

clue.text: Young person holds first-class climbing for large number

indicators.note: the young person contains the other piece

parts.note: a child is a young person

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: A1 is first-class, written AI

explanation.surface: A youngster holding on to a top-notch climb.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiliad is a group of a thousand, certainly a large number.

clue.text: Eating-place in which I do morning salads

indicators.note: a salad is a mixture, so the words are tossed together into a new order

explanation.surface: A room where someone prepares salads in the mornings.
explanation.definitionFit: The dining room is where a household eats.

clue.text: Means of catching a girl with love

parts.note: lass is a word for a girl
love is nil in tennis scoring, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Advice on how a man might win a young woman's heart.
explanation.definitionFit: A rope with a running noose is the cowboy's means of catching cattle.

clue.text: Withdrawal as a result of meeting outside the community

indicators.note: one word stands around the other, so the community sits inside the meeting

parts.note: a session is a sitting or meeting of a body
EC is the European Community

explanation.surface: Someone withdraws after a gathering held away from the group.
explanation.definitionFit: Secession is formally leaving a federation or organisation, a withdrawal.

clue.text: Hot-looking athlete or climber

parts.note: scarlet is the colour of something hot or flushed
a runner is an athlete

explanation.surface: A flushed sportsman or a mountaineer.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarlet runner is a climbing bean plant.

clue.text: Organisation which takes a film star on after a diet

indicators.note: the film star and 'on' are placed after the diet

parts.note: a regimen is a prescribed diet
Jacques Tati was a French comic film actor and director
taken as written

explanation.surface: An agency signs up a film actor once he has finished his diet.
explanation.walkthrough: Jacques Tati, star of Monsieur Hulot's Holiday, supplies TATI; 'on' is then added literally after him.
explanation.definitionFit: Regimentation is strict ordering of things, a kind of rigid organisation.

clue.text: What tourists may take to make teams bat so badly

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Sides playing cricket so poorly that tourists leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Tourists might take river cruisers powered by steam.

clue.text: Providing hospitality, making one dine in town

indicators.note: the eating is put in the town's name

parts.note: Tring is a small market town in Hertfordshire, England
to dine is to eat

explanation.surface: Being a generous host by taking a guest out to dinner in town.
explanation.walkthrough: TRING is a small town in Hertfordshire, England; put EAT inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Treating someone means standing them food or drink as a host.

clue.text: Machine which is powerless in the air

definitions.text: Machine which is powerless in the air

parts.words: Machine which is powerless in the air
parts.note: sounds like a broken-down device, but describes an aircraft built to fly without an engine

explanation.surface: An engine that has failed while flying.
explanation.definitionFit: An unpowered aircraft carried by air currents is a machine with no power aloft.

clue.text: Spills for bargees

definitions.meaning: spills are thin tapers for lighting fires
bargees work on flat-bottomed barges called by the same name

explanation.definitionFit: Tapers and lighting devices kindle fires; flat barges used to unload ships are worked by bargemen.

clue.text: Song which gives an industrious one the edge

parts.note: the ant is proverbially industrious
a hem is the edge of a piece of cloth

explanation.surface: A song that gives a hard worker an advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: An anthem is a solemn song, such as a national one.

clue.text: A portion ordered chapter in article

indicators.note: the two pieces go inside the article

parts.note: the is the definite article
ran means managed or ordered

explanation.surface: A section of a chapter is arranged within an article.
explanation.definitionFit: A tranche is a slice or instalment of something.

clue.text: Exam which makes letters a toy

parts.note: Litt. is the abbreviation for letters, as in Litt.D, Doctor of Letters
Lego is the toy building-brick set

explanation.surface: An exam that turns written characters into a plaything.
explanation.walkthrough: The Little Go was the old preliminary exam at Cambridge University.
explanation.definitionFit: The Little Go was the nickname of Cambridge's former entrance or preliminary examination.

clue.text: I wear myself out in reverse now they have retired

indicators.note: the phrase's letters are read from end to start

parts.note: I tire me says I wear myself out

explanation.surface: An exhausted professor explains that colleagues have now retired.
explanation.walkthrough: Turn the phrase into I TIRE ME, then read it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Emeriti are professors who have retired but keep their title.

clue.text: Getting on a ship to put up somewhere a stay

parts.note: boarding is getting on a ship
to house someone is to put them up

explanation.surface: A traveller gets on a vessel to find a place to stay.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads oddly as held; it means a place for a stay, somewhere to lodge.
explanation.definitionFit: A guesthouse where lodgers take rooms and meals is a place to stay.

clue.text: Concerned with the drink rising in the river

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means reading from bottom to top

parts.note: re means concerning
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Someone worried about alcohol going up in the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Niger is a major river of West Africa.

clue.text: Goddess who makes a man live

parts.note: he refers to a man
to be is to live or exist

explanation.surface: A goddess who brings a man to life.
explanation.definitionFit: Hebe was the Greek goddess of youth.

clue.text: A most villainous person spoils our charge

indicators.note: to spoil the words is to mess them up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone thoroughly wicked is ruining the case we are bringing.
explanation.definitionFit: An arch-rogue is a chief scoundrel, the worst of villains.

clue.text: The sound of the organ gripping one

indicators.note: the organ holds the other piece tightly inside it

parts.note: the nose is the organ of smell
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A sound made by a musical organ gripping a single note.
explanation.definitionFit: Noise is sound, especially loud or unwanted sound.

clue.text: Kind of Conservatives return for something to eat

indicators.note: the word comes back on itself, so it is read backwards

parts.note: wets were moderate Conservatives in Thatcher's time

explanation.surface: Some Tories come back for a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: WETS was Margaret Thatcher's word for moderate members of her Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A stew is a dish of slowly simmered meat and vegetables.

clue.text: Goddess who makes a writer languish

parts.note: a proser is a writer of prose
to pine is to languish

explanation.surface: A deity who causes an author to waste away.
explanation.definitionFit: Proserpine is the Roman queen of the underworld, the Greek Persephone.
